changes: Reopening the app during setup no longer covers the current step with a language picker
Retain found device row and display error feedback with How to Pair guidance when device connection fails.
In the Omi tutorial, reopening a step from the summary shows what you already did and brings you back to the summary
In the Omi tutorial, a question sent automatically after 15 seconds now gets its answer and lets you continue
Offline Sync shows each recording as one row instead of dozens of 1 to 3 minute pieces; tap it to see the pieces.
If a reply to an app review fails to send, the app now says so and keeps your text instead of showing a false success.
When Omi changes a task, memory, conversation or person from chat, it shows what changed with a one-tap Undo, and Omi links open straight in the app.
Omi no longer says it is fully charged the moment you put it on the charger.
Memories recover automatically from temporary loading failures, keeping your saved memories available while you try again.
On-device transcription times each transcript segment from the recording's real length, so 8 kHz recordings are no longer stamped at half their duration
Offline recordings sync more reliably without repeated uploads or misleading server-busy messages.
AI app generator suggestion strip scales dynamically with text size to prevent card overflows
Apps category sections scale row and header heights dynamically to prevent overflows at larger text sizes
Telegram and iMessage replies show clearer formatting and compact links to your Omi items.
An Omi link to several conversations, tasks and memories opens them as one list in the app.
Show your actual plan name in Settings and plan-change confirmation
Show the monthly allowance meter for metered paid plans, including Plus
Internet detection is more reliable on restricted networks, while offline recordings continue to save safely.
Settings search header maintains a stable height and alignment to prevent rows jumping on open and cancel
Smoother scrolling, transcripts, and chat typing across the app
Pendant recordings waiting in Offline Sync upload four times as much audio per request, so a large backlog clears faster.
Receive your actual subscription tier and keep older client plan decoding safe
Referral signup opens in your browser, and failed integration checks offer a retry instead of hanging or claiming a connection before authorization finishes.
A recording that is too short or empty now explains why it did not become a conversation.
Choose how you capture during setup and turn your first phone recording into a conversation.
Your introduction now shows what Omi heard, lets you type answers, and gives you a first answer based on what you saved.
Leaving the voice introduction and coming back, or reopening on the all-set screen, no longer restarts the introduction or saves the goal twice
No user-facing change yet: groundwork for testing paywall designs (the current plans sheet, a new soft paywall, and a web-rendered paywall) and a web-rendered onboarding, each switched on remotely.
Stop repeated sync polling when rate limited and allow clearing stuck uploaded recordings via Delete Pending.
A voice-intro answer that was already sent stays locked if the save is not acknowledged, so a retry does not store a second copy
Conversation tasks focus on your commitments and avoid repeated tasks after recording updates.
Settings now has Connect an Agent, which opens setup prompts and keys for Claude, ChatGPT, Codex, and other agents
Conversations use learned names more consistently and detect their spoken language more reliably.
See the surrounding conversation when answering spelling questions in Review.
App cards remain readable at larger text sizes
Offline Sync now shows progress in minutes of audio instead of file counts, with a Sync details sheet for troubleshooting
Clearer recording instructions, actionable pairing errors, and easier onboarding choices.
Your Omi shows as connected again when you reopen the app, instead of staying stuck on Disconnected while it's actually connected

changes.change: On iOS, phone-microphone batch capture uses less battery after you return to the app, by tightening timer precision only while it is actually needed

changes: Reverts an Android battery optimization before release: reconnect retries keep the proven steady cadence after your Omi leaves and returns to range
No user-facing change: internal test robustness fix for a date-sensitive widget test.
